# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and M152** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and the Skia m152 engine. This release also expands native package support, improves memory safety and allocation behavior, and refreshes the renderer with upstream servicing updates.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone m152 and incorporates upstream m151 and m152 servicing changes. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — Adds managed bindings for Skia's Graphite backend on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel reads** — SKImage and SKSurface now offer backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel-source lifetime fixes** — SKRegion iteration, SKPixmap subsets and derived pixmaps now retain their native sources for as long as consumers can use them. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Raster-image failure cleanup** — SKImage.Create now releases its pixel buffer when raster-image creation fails. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Runtime-effect uniform buffers are released on reset** — Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms now disposes the previous uniform buffer instead of retaining native memory. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))
- **HarfBuzz blob conversion releases temporary streams** — Converting non-memory-backed SKStreamAsset instances to HarfBuzz blobs no longer retains the temporary stream. ([#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))

## Platform

- **Native symbols and Vulkan package availability expanded** — Apple native symbol packages are produced during packing, Android symbols have deterministic identities, and the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package is available again. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))
- **Nano Server font support** — Nano Server uses FreeType for font support, enabling text rendering on that Windows container platform. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves HarfBuzzSharp shaping and tag-formatting performance while refining package documentation and cross-platform packaging.
